title: Replace character anchor still
description: One still: a frame from the clip with the people replaced by the uploaded pictures, so the replacement can be approved before any video is made. The frame is the edit target and the first reference; the pictures follow as second and third references, so each picture lands on its own person. Meant for a clip already made clean (a screen recording's app icons removed); the still keeps the frame's pose, position, scale, light and background.

evidence: The graph is the reviewed Flux 2 Klein edit shape (native-workflows/flux2-klein-edit) with the clip frame read as a reference latent and two character pictures chained after it as extra reference latents; the output is resized back to the frame's own size.

Real run on the local ComfyUI 0.37.0 worker (RTX 4090, 24 GB) on the user's clip: three fresh stills took 8.2 s, 8.2 s and 12.4 s at 1206x904 after the 4B model was loaded; an unchanged graph is served from ComfyUI's cache in about 1 s. The still keeps the orange wall, microphone and light; both people were replaced with their pictures' full outfits and accessories (badges, cap, strap, watch). Identity fidelity on other footage, memory use and a run with one picture remain unqualified; see docs/REPLACE-ANCHOR.md.

2026-10-31: the FLUX 2 Klein reference edit (3 pictures) was replaced by the core nodes of the official Comfy-Org template image_fibo2_edit_turbo_pe.json (Fibo 2.0 Edit Turbo int8, 4 steps); the pictures keep their order on TextEncodeFibo2's image sockets and every other node is unchanged. User decision: no FLUX 2 or Qwen for editing.
